description: Version-pinned cross-SDK identity vectors (guard G1). Python SDK, JS SDK and Backend load this exact file and pin its sha256. Each vector names the rule it exercises in its rule field; the allowed values are closed_sets.rule.

sources.js_registration_rule: JS SDK: the registration key is agentName when set, otherwise the resolved function name (deriveFunctionName: trim, strip leading "bound " prefixes); see the vectors for the exact outcomes
sources.backend_agent_key_rule: Backend registration key: drop non-printable characters, collapse whitespace runs to one space, trim, empty -> traigent_function; keep a name matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128} as is; otherwise <slug>-<first 10 hex of sha256(UTF-8 text)> with the slug truncated to 117 characters; reference implementation: backend_agent_key() in tests/test_identity_vectors_v1.py
sources.python_known_environment_labels: Traigent traigent/utils/env_config.py:227 (_KNOWN_ENVIRONMENT_NAMES = _PRODUCTION_ENV_NAMES | _NON_PRODUCTION_ENV_NAMES | {"ci"}; sets at :224-226) @d33cc24cd (origin/develop); accepted-environment rule: an explicit argument is a free label; every environment-variable source accepts only the known labels

notes: Native reason precedence when several apply: ineligible (any scope not function_derived, or empty ledger), then incomplete (never finalized), then conflict (different keys), then open_scope (a scope still open), else attributed.
OTLP strict rule: differing gen_ai.agent.id labels -> conflict; any span without a label -> incomplete; unreadable metadata -> evidence_unavailable; unreadable is checked first.

Environment: an explicit argument is a free label (trim + lower-case, at most 64 after trim, else error too_long, no fallthrough; the SDK raises; empty/whitespace = unset). EVERY env-var rung (TRAIGENT_ENVIRONMENT, OTel deployment.environment.name from OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, ENVIRONMENT, TRAIGENT_ENV) is accepted only if its trimmed lower-cased value is in closed_sets.known_environment_labels; anything else (empty, over 64, unknown label, email-like text) is ignored with warning invalid_env_value_ignored (value-free) and resolution falls through; the warning field holds invalid_env_value_ignored in preference to later warnings. Result is default (warning invalid_env_value_ignored if something was ignored, else undeclared_default) when nothing valid remains. Free labels such as team/eu are valid only as an explicit argument.

Anchor: every vector is anchor=consumer. Each consumer MUST run its real production functions against every vector it covers (guard G1); the reference implementation in tests/test_identity_vectors_v1.py only proves the file is self-consistent. scripts/verify_identity_vectors_against_production.py is a one-off check of the Python SDK functions.

Native snapshots: process snapshots in delivery order. A snapshot with an incoming end time sets the stored identity to its agent_id; a snapshot without one clears it (a stale early snapshot erasing final identity is accepted recall loss). Attribution needs a stored identity at the end; no end-time snapshot -> incomplete; end-time snapshot without identity -> ineligible. persisted_ended_at_present never grants attribution.
trace_agent_id for function_derived is the canonical backend key, equal to backend_agent_key.
late_after_record vectors: the recorded result never changes; the counter increments.

provenance.description: Python, no names: self-describing default, function_derived

Python, no objectives given: the decorator supplies the default objective accuracy (decorators.py@36c18c9d:2007-2023,3280,3378-3380); a decorated function must have at least one knob (empty configuration space raises ValueError)
Python, more than max_knobs=4 knobs: first four then ,...
Python, function-name prefix cut to the 120-char cap and marked ~
Python, explicit agent_name: user_named, no trace id
Python nested function: __qualname__ has <locals> but __name__ does not; only a __name__ containing < is ineligible, so function_derived (same-name collisions are inherent to function-derived keys)
Python callable whose __name__ itself contains '<locals>': ineligible
Python functools.partial: no __name__; real decoration raises AttributeError at decorators.py:3278, so the outcome is unsupported (not_decoratable), not a registration
Python lambda with explicit agent_name: user_named wins over ineligible
JS, no names: registration key is the derived function name, function_derived
JS bound function: 'bound ' prefix stripped by deriveFunctionName
JS declared manifest agentId equal to the registration key: user_named
JS declared manifest agentId != registration key: user_named, trace id withheld, local warning
JS function named 'anonymous': falls to anonymous_js_trial, ineligible
JS no function name and no agentName: anonymous_js_trial, ineligible

trace_attribution.description: One eligible scope A closed before end_trace
Nested function-derived A -> B: conflict
Nested scopes both function-derived with the same key A: attributed
Unscoped handler root (neutral, no scope) + one eligible scope A: attributed. Deliberate difference from OTLP, which is strict
Function-derived A -> user_named B: poisoned
Function-derived A -> anonymous child: poisoned
user_named parent -> anonymous child: unattributed
Outer eligible A still open after inner B closed (end_trace ran inside A): withheld
Outer eligible A still open, inner scope same key A closed: withheld as open_scope
Single eligible scope A still open at finalization: withheld as open_scope
Outer ineligible A open after inner B closed: withheld
Two distinct lambdas with identical knobs in one trace: neither attributed
Standalone observed function, empty scope ledger: no agent id
Early batch/timer flush before finalization, then end_trace publishes the final snapshot: attributed from the final snapshot only
Trace flushed early and never finalized: withheld
Child scope B closes after an early flush; final ledger is A -> B: conflict
Every span labelled A

Unscoped root span (no gen_ai.agent.id) + scoped child: strict OTLP rule leaves the trace unattributed. Deliberate difference from native, where the unscoped root is neutral and the trace is attributed
Nested A -> B spans carry different labels: conflict
A -> user_named B: boundary span without label
A -> anonymous child: boundary span without label
user_named parent -> anonymous child: neither labelled
JS A -> named B returning a constant: B emits an unlabelled boundary span
Two distinct JS anonymous scopes: unlabelled boundary spans
One unlabelled span among labelled A spans
Spans delivered in order, one batch (control for the reorder/split vectors)
Same spans delivered child-first, root late, in separate batches: same result as in-order
Conflicting spans split across two deliveries: conflict regardless of split
Unlabelled span arrives in a later batch before evaluation: unattributed
Offloaded span metadata cannot be read at evaluation: fail closed
Late unlabelled span after the window was recorded: recorded result unchanged, counter incremented
Legacy trace: trace-level agent_id only, no span keys: attributed as today
Final snapshot carries the end time and K: attributed
Early snapshot carries K but no end time and no final snapshot follows: ignored, incomplete
Early snapshot without identity, then the final snapshot with end time and K: attributed
Final snapshot arrives before a stale early one; the stale snapshot erases identity on storage: accepted recall loss, incomplete
Persisted ended_at present (rollup-synthesised) but the incoming snapshot has no end time: not attributed
Final snapshot with end time but no agent id: ineligible

environment.description: Explicit argument beats every env var
TRAIGENT_ENVIRONMENT beats OTel, ENVIRONMENT, TRAIGENT_ENV
OTel deployment.environment.name (from OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES) beats ENVIRONMENT and TRAIGENT_ENV
ENVIRONMENT beats legacy TRAIGENT_ENV
Legacy TRAIGENT_ENV is honoured with a deprecation warning
Nothing declared: 'default' plus a one-time warning
Other well-known variables never imply an environment: NODE_ENV=production and similar are ignored
Explicit value is trimmed and lower-cased
Env var value is trimmed and lower-cased
Free text with a slash is valid and preserved (lower-cased) as an explicit argument
64 characters after normalization is valid
65 characters after normalization in the explicit argument is a programmer error: error too_long, no fallthrough (the SDK raises)
Empty or whitespace explicit argument is treated as unset
Empty TRAIGENT_ENVIRONMENT is ignored with a warning; ENVIRONMENT is used
65-char TRAIGENT_ENVIRONMENT is ignored with a warning; ENVIRONMENT is used
Only invalid env-var values: ignored with a warning, result default
An email-like value in TRAIGENT_ENV is not a known label: ignored with a value-free warning, result default
An unknown label in TRAIGENT_ENVIRONMENT is ignored; a known ENVIRONMENT value is used
An unknown OTel deployment.environment.name is ignored; a known ENVIRONMENT value is used
An unknown ENVIRONMENT value alone: ignored, result default
Unknown TRAIGENT_ENVIRONMENT falls through to a known legacy TRAIGENT_ENV; the ignored-value warning wins
ci is a known label
65 characters that trim to 64 is valid
